تستهجني (form X)
# تَسْتَهْجِنِي (tastahjinī) /tas.tah.d͡ʒi.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# تُسْتَهْجَنِي (tustahjanī) /tus.tah.d͡ʒa.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
